text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Higher tariffs on cigarettes and tobacco as of July, customs official says.
- Gulf Bank and International Investor Co sign three-year accord to market investment portifolios governed by Islamic banking rules.
- Kuwait Airways plans to promote tourism to the Far East, official says.
- Iraq says it has no Kuwaiti prisoners of war. Kuwait says Iraq is holding about 600 people since the 1990-91 Gulf crisis.
- More than 50 percent of the 50 million dinar polypropylene project has been completed, official says.
- Men should be banned from working at boutiques which sell ladies' garments, a member of Kuwait Municipal Council proposed.
